reviews.review_description:
Im new to meta quest but this was a fun experience. The graphics arent for everyone but i really like the style. The weather and day and night change which makes the world feel alive. 

The tutorial is great and straightforward for anyone new getting into vr like myself. The weapon system works well, handling different weapons and stabbing the dummy is fun in itself 😂

The cars are a lot of fun, the developer said he is going to improve the car system in his discord so im looking forward to the improvements.

This is a very ambitious project and theres a lot of systems that are working. Appreciate the work thats put in. I wishlisted and preorder. Im going to support the developer. streets of Miami!!!

reviews.review_title: Not perfect but closest thing to gta VR
reviews.review_description:
Honestly title says it all, i want more. Ive been a tester since the early stages of this game when it ran at 5fps and the map was just one long road… 

Its insane to see how far this game has come in such a short amount of times. Pre-ordered.

Update: the new npc voices are a nice touch, some of the cars are broken but im still excited to see whats to come of this.
The demo shows great promise and I'm looking forward to checking out the full game. Its a demo and i already want more. I really like the stylized graphics.

reviews.review_description:
Oh great here we go again, another vr game that would’ve just stayed in App Lab had Meta not taken it down. Thankfully this is just a demo and it’s free… but I still hated every second of it.

Let me tell you something right now, if you’re going to release a demo of an app that’s free, and you want people to play a snippet of said game that you’re working on, you would think that “Oh man this is going to MAKE me want to play the real thing when it comes out!” Unfortunately though we seem to live in an era where we have grown tolerant of games that look like they were made in Alice back in the day and the game barely looks passable for an alpha, and we’re all supposed to pretend to pretend that “OH FOR A META QUEST GAME THIS LOOKS AMAZING!” As if there aren’t meta quest games from 5 YEARS AGO that look infinitely better than this, I.e. Resist and Stride Fates which came out 3 years ago.

The opening cutscene on paper would have looked cool had I not been able to see a bunch of clustered polygons in the water that just disappeared every time I slightly turned my head, and the sharks are just in the water for absolutely no reason and they just sit there, and from this you’re supposed to look at the airplane flying in the sky and then you see the cruise ship and as soon as you get closer to the ship the whole thing just tilts and it looks like you’re about to crash on to the ship… already such a bizarre cutscene and it didn’t need to be there. You might as well have just given us a flat screen view of a stock airplane flying around.

When you make it to the actual game though you are put into a building that you immediately fall out of a window of for absolutely no reason, and then the open world happens. The graphics are genuinely the absolute worst thing ever, because the cars don’t even look like 3d models, they look like a bunch of PNG images held together, and the cars are just stuck in the ground, the wheels aren’t even positioned correctly to make it feel like they’re on the ground, and the buildings themselves literally look like google earth except the 3d images forgot to continue rendering.

The NPCs look bad as well, their faces up close look like they were scribbled on by a toddler, and their behavior is just bizarre, every time you are merely SEEN by them, they immediately start running away and they’ll just run away and vanish into thin air, and I’m supposed to pretend like this is normal for an early access vr game.

When they do try to fight you, they have the stamina of a paper bag, because you merely grab them once and they just go flying into the air, FROM MERELY GRABBING THEM MIND YOU!

There was one part where I found a motorcycle and I was able to get it running and I could drive it around and the game didn’t even bother putting me in the seat, you just grab the handle with one hand and the motorcycle itself just moved with you, not immersive at all.

If this was supposed to be what got me wanting to play the game, considering that the devs RELEASED THIS TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC FOR US TO PLAY, REGARDLESS IF IF IT’S IN EARLY ACCESS, then you have failed miserably.

developer_response.body:
The shader is a toon shader that I wrote for the game to have a specific art style LOL. Minimalist art style was the direction i was actually going in but i appreciate your opinion. Im working with a decal artist to add that those little details that youre saying make a big difference.

i do use A.I. for some images ive shown pretty clearly in my tutorials and twitch work streams, not something I hide... i just work to make it as high quality as possible or something that would represent the time.

For example, getting real gangs from the 1980's and feeding their logos and my research to ai so it can produce something similar, then i can edit or adjust in adobe illustrator or photoshop.. So i think youre dismissing the work thats actually going in there haha. But im super glad you got to experience it...

the game has black jack, pool, basket ball, mini golf in this version of the demo... i have a car dealer ship, taxi side missions, texture settings and more all being worked and in the pipeline for release :) (as well as the story mode & online)

appreciate you taking the time for playing & can re-evaluate your review & game in the future! 

join the discord for more updates!

reviews.review_description:
Its absolutely amazing and its only going to get better. I get the vibe of scarface and mark ekkos getting up when i play this. The gangsters look like theyre out of the warriors movie. Im pretty excited for this, i know theres a lot of work to be done but you cant tell how much work has been put into this!

You can spray paint, play basketball, hit big jumps around the city with different types of cars or motor cycles, sell “things” to make more money to buy customizable apartments around the map. If youre looking for something different, gta vr style open world sand box type of game i recommend this.

Cant wait for a story line to come out for this
